means.了: 了 after a verb says the action happened and is done: 买了一本书 'bought a book'.
means.过: 过 says you have done it at some time in your life, as an experience: 去过北京 'have been to Beijing'.
means.着: 着 says a state goes on, or that one thing is done while doing another: 站着说话 'talk standing up'.

items.zh: 我去[过]中国，那里很漂亮。
items.en: I've been to China. It's beautiful there.
items.why: Something you have done at some point in your life: 过.

items.en: He said with a smile: no problem.
items.why: Doing one thing (smiling) while doing another (speaking): 着.

items.en: I bought a book yesterday.
items.why: One action that happened and is done: 了.

items.en: Have you ever had Chinese food?
items.why: 'Ever' asks about an experience: 过.

items.en: It's raining outside.
items.why: Something going on right now: 着…呢.

items.en: They are talking standing up.
items.why: The way they talk (standing): 着.

items.en: I've never tried this dish.
items.why: Never yet, as an experience: 没…过.

items.zh: 他喝[了]两杯咖啡就走了。
items.en: He drank two cups of coffee and then left.
items.why: One finished action, then the next: 了.

items.en: Have we met before?
items.why: Have we ever met: an experience, 过.

means.的: 的 joins a describing word or an owner to a noun: 我的书, 红色的衣服.
means.地: 地 comes after a describing word and before a verb: how someone does it, 高兴地说.
means.得: 得 comes after a verb and says how well, fast or much it is done: 跑得很快.

items.en: This is my book.
items.why: An owner + noun: 的.

items.en: He runs fast.
items.why: Verb + 得 + how well: 得.

items.en: She said happily: thank you!
items.why: How she said it, before the verb: 地.

items.en: You're right. (What you said is right.)
items.why: Verb + 得 + a judgement of it: 得.

items.en: Let's walk slowly.
items.why: How we walk, before the verb: 地.

items.en: The red one is mine.
items.why: A describing word + the thing: 的.

items.en: He speaks Chinese very well.
items.why: Verb + 得 + how well: 得.

items.en: This is food Mum made.
items.why: 妈妈做 describes the noun 菜: 的.

items.en: The children are playing happily.
items.why: How they play, before the verb: 地.

title: 比, 没有 or 最?

means.比: A 比 B + describing word: A is more … than B.
means.没有: A 没有 B + describing word: A is not as … as B.
means.最: 最 + describing word: the most … of all.

items.en: My older brother is three years older than me.
items.why: A is more than B, by an amount: 比.

items.en: This one isn't as nice as that one.
items.why: Not as … as: 没有.

items.en: He's the tallest in our class.
items.why: The most of all: 最.

items.en: Today is much hotter than yesterday.
items.why: 比 + describing word + 多了 'much more'. 没有 cannot take 多了.

items.en: I'm not as busy as he is.
items.why: 没有 + B + 那么 + describing word: not as … as.

items.zh: 这是我吃过的[最]好吃的菜。
items.en: This is the best food I've ever eaten.
items.why: The most of all: 最.

items.en: Flying is faster than taking the train.
items.why: A is more … than B: 比.

items.en: Today isn't as cold as yesterday.
items.why: Not as … as: 没有.

items.en: What colour do you like best?
items.why: Best of all: 最.

means.从: 从 is 'from': where or when something starts, often with 到 'to'.
means.离: 离 is the distance between two places or times: A 离 B 很近 / 很远 / 还有….
means.往: 往 is 'towards': the direction you go.

items.en: My home is close to the school.
items.why: Distance between two places: 离.

items.en: I come from China.
items.why: Where it starts: 从.

items.en: Go straight ahead and you're there.
items.why: The direction you go: 往.

items.en: There are three days left until the exam.
items.why: Distance in time: 离…还有.

items.zh: 他每天[从]早上八点工作到下午五点。
items.en: Every day he works from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m.
items.why: From … to …: 从…到….

items.en: Look to the left: that's the hospital.
items.why: A direction: 往.

items.zh: [从]这儿到火车站要多长时间？
items.en: How long does it take from here to the train station?
items.why: From here to there: 从…到….

items.en: Is your home far from here?
items.why: Distance between two places: 离.

items.en: This bus goes towards the airport.
items.why: The direction it goes: 往.
